definitions.recall_open: Validly detected overrun jobs before planned closure / all jobs with true final cost >110% of budget.
definitions.precision: Valid catches / all emitted alerts, including repeated dismissed alerts; oracle-manager simulation convention.
definitions.share_after_close: Validly detected overrun jobs caught at/after closure / all validly detected overrun jobs, not all alerts.
definitions.addressable_share: Injected driver cost on true-overrun jobs scheduled at/after the first valid alert / all injected driver cost on those jobs; zero response delay, not realized savings.
definitions.addressable_share_2day: Same driver-cost metric, requiring cost to occur at least two working days after the valid alert.
definitions.alerts_per_week: Emitted alerts for the 1,200-job test cohort / 50.4 working weeks; normalized annual-cohort load.
definitions.model_score: Classifier score for observed final overrun >10% AND current learned-curve excess >3% of budget; not calibrated final-overrun probability.
definitions.false_alarm_anatomy: Distinct non-overrun jobs receiving at least one emitted ML alert, not false-alert events; categories may overlap.

methodology.data: One fixed-seed synthetic plant; no real-ERP, customer or user validation.
methodology.data_quality_rates: Scenario percentages are nominal probabilities. Mis-coding attempts can select the same active job; realized wrong-job shares are therefore slightly lower.
methodology.training: Only closed previous-year jobs and postings available before test start. Cohorts are degraded separately. Learned curves fit inside the training fold before calibration, then refit on all eligible history.
methodology.calibration: Job-level 25% validation split. All daily arms use daily snapshots and two consecutive daily threshold exceedances. Rules and ML choose thresholds on validation only: maximize remaining driver cost subject to precision >=50%. If infeasible, the highest-precision candidate is exported as diagnostic only.
methodology.realert: All arms use a five-working-day cooldown after a dismissed alert. First valid catch stops further alerts.
methodology.manager: Oracle simulation: manager knows whether final true cost exceeds budget by >10% and whether injected cause is active. This does not represent observed human accuracy or speed.
methodology.month_end: Fixed 10% variance vs phased plan; only postings visible before month-end; report five working days later. No accruals or arrivals during close.
methodology.deployment: A prototype, not approved for production. Validation and held-out precision checks are reported separately; simulation pass is not field validation.
methodology.limitations: One stationary synthetic data-generating process and seed; no uncertainty interval, measured intervention effect, calibrated probability, or evidence of willingness to pay. Cost still ahead may be committed or unavoidable. Zero-delay and two-day-delay opportunities are both shown.
methodology.model_target: Classifier score for observed final overrun >10% AND current learned-curve excess >3% of budget; not calibrated final-overrun probability.
